positions.name: ReactionDeliveryBundlingAndBatchingBoundary
positions.frame: Where should reaction delivery bundling and batching windows be bounded across multi-skill runs?
positions.why: The set articulates the delivery architecture for reactions: establishing single-bundle delivery per run per recipient to reduce cognitive overhead, holding a strict run-close batching boundary despite pushback from Tina, and explicitly rejecting client-side collapsing to avoid passing ordering complexity to the reader.
